quests.instruction: Find the lowercase letter for Ninja!
quests.question: n
quests.hint: Think of Ninja — that's what this letter starts! 🥷
quests.explanation: Great work! n is the letter that starts Ninja. 🥷
quests.funFact: Ninjas wore dark blue clothes at night, not black, to blend in better with the sky!

quests.instruction: Find the lowercase letter for Owl!
quests.question: o
quests.hint: It has a round circle, like a little wheel.
quests.explanation: Well done! You know your letters — o starts the word Owl.
quests.funFact: Owls can't move their eyeballs, so they have to turn their entire heads to look around!

quests.instruction: Find the lowercase letter for Penguin!
quests.question: p
quests.hint: It has a tall line that dips below, with a round bump on top.
quests.explanation: Well done! You know your letters — p starts the word Penguin.
quests.funFact: Penguins don't have teeth; they have fleshy spines inside their mouths to swallow fish!

quests.instruction: Find the uppercase letter for Quilt!
quests.question: Q
quests.hint: Think of Quilt — that's what this letter starts! 🛌
quests.explanation: Great work! Q is the letter that starts Quilt. 🛌
quests.funFact: The oldest known quilt is over 2,000 years old!

quests.instruction: Find the uppercase letter for Robot!
quests.question: R
quests.hint: It has a tall line with a round bump on top and a leg kicking out.
quests.explanation: Well done! You know your letters — R starts the word Robot.
quests.funFact: The word 'robot' comes from a Czech word meaning forced labor!

quests.instruction: Find the uppercase letter for Shark!
quests.question: S
quests.hint: It has a curvy line that curls one way then the other.
quests.explanation: Well done! You know your letters — S starts the word Shark.
quests.funFact: Sharks have been on Earth longer than trees have!

quests.instruction: Find the lowercase letter for Tiger!
quests.question: t
quests.hint: Think of Tiger — that's what this letter starts! 🐅
quests.explanation: Great work! t is the letter that starts Tiger. 🐅
quests.funFact: A tiger's stripes are like fingerprints; no two tigers have the exact same pattern!

quests.instruction: Find the lowercase letter for Unicorn!
quests.question: u
quests.hint: It has a curved dip with a short straight line on the right side.
quests.explanation: Well done! You know your letters — u starts the word Unicorn.
quests.funFact: The unicorn is the national animal of Scotland!

quests.instruction: Find the lowercase letter for Volcano!
quests.question: v
quests.hint: It has two short lines meeting in a point at the bottom, like a checkmark.
quests.explanation: Well done! You know your letters — v starts the word Volcano.
quests.funFact: There are volcanoes on other planets, and the biggest one is on Mars!

quests.instruction: Find the uppercase letter for Whale!
quests.question: W
quests.hint: Think of Whale — that's what this letter starts! 🐋
quests.explanation: Great work! W is the letter that starts Whale. 🐋
quests.funFact: The blue whale is the largest animal ever known to have lived on Earth!

quests.instruction: Find the uppercase letter for X-ray!
quests.question: X
quests.hint: It has two slanted lines crossing in the middle.
quests.explanation: Well done! You know your letters — X starts the word X-ray.
quests.funFact: X-rays were discovered completely by accident in 1895!

quests.instruction: Find the uppercase letter for Yak!
quests.question: Y
quests.hint: It has two short lines meeting in the middle, sitting on one straight line.
quests.explanation: Well done! You know your letters — Y starts the word Yak.
quests.funFact: Yaks have larger lungs and hearts than most cattle to help them live in high mountains!

quests.instruction: Find the lowercase letter for Zoo!
quests.question: z
quests.hint: Think of Zoo — that's what this letter starts! 🦁
quests.explanation: Great work! z is the letter that starts Zoo. 🦁
quests.funFact: The oldest zoo in the world still operating today is in Vienna, built in 1752!

quests.instruction: Find the lowercase letter for Astronaut!
quests.question: a
quests.hint: It has a small circle with a short line on the right side.
quests.explanation: Well done! You know your letters — a starts the word Astronaut.
quests.funFact: Astronauts can grow up to two inches taller while living in space!

quests.instruction: Find the lowercase letter for Bear!
quests.question: b
quests.hint: It has a tall straight line with one round bump at the bottom.
quests.explanation: Well done! You know your letters — b starts the word Bear.
quests.funFact: Bears have an incredible sense of smell, much better than a dog's!

quests.instruction: Find the uppercase letter for Car!
quests.question: C
quests.hint: Think of Car — that's what this letter starts! 🚗
quests.explanation: Great work! C is the letter that starts Car. 🚗
quests.funFact: The first cars didn't have steering wheels; drivers used a lever!

quests.instruction: Find the uppercase letter for Dinosaur!
quests.question: D
quests.hint: It has a tall straight line with one big round curve on the right.
quests.explanation: Well done! You know your letters — D starts the word Dinosaur.
quests.funFact: Some dinosaurs were as small as a chicken!

quests.instruction: Find the uppercase letter for Earth!
quests.question: E
quests.hint: It has a tall straight line with three short lines like little shelves.
quests.explanation: Well done! You know your letters — E starts the word Earth.
quests.funFact: Earth is the only planet in our solar system not named after a god!

quests.instruction: Find the lowercase letter for Firetruck!
quests.question: f
quests.hint: It has a tall line with a small crossbar, like a tiny flagpole.
quests.explanation: Well done! You know your letters — f starts the word Firetruck.
quests.funFact: Early firetrucks were actually pulled by horses, not engines!

quests.instruction: Find the lowercase letter for Gorilla!
quests.question: g
quests.hint: It has a small circle with a curved tail that hangs below the line.
quests.explanation: Well done! You know your letters — g starts the word Gorilla.
quests.funFact: Gorillas can learn sign language and communicate with humans!

quests.instruction: Find the lowercase letter for Horse!
quests.question: h
quests.hint: It has a tall straight line with a curved leg beside it.
quests.explanation: Well done! You know your letters — h starts the word Horse.
quests.funFact: Horses can sleep both standing up and lying down!

quests.instruction: Find the uppercase letter for Igloo!
quests.question: I
quests.hint: It has one tall, straight line standing alone.
quests.explanation: Well done! You know your letters — I starts the word Igloo.
quests.funFact: An igloo can be 40 degrees warmer inside than outside, just from body heat!

quests.instruction: Find the uppercase letter for Jellyfish!
quests.question: J
quests.hint: It has a tall line that curves into a hook at the bottom.
quests.explanation: Well done! You know your letters — J starts the word Jellyfish.
quests.funFact: Jellyfish don't have brains, hearts, or bones, and are 95% water!

quests.instruction: Find the uppercase letter for Kangaroo!
quests.question: K
quests.hint: It has a tall straight line with two legs kicking out to the side.
quests.explanation: Well done! You know your letters — K starts the word Kangaroo.
quests.funFact: Kangaroos use their strong tails for balance, so if you lift their tail, they can't hop!

quests.instruction: Find the lowercase letter for Lemon!
quests.question: l
quests.hint: It has one tall, straight line standing alone.
quests.explanation: Well done! You know your letters — l starts the word Lemon.
quests.funFact: Lemons contain more sugar than strawberries!

quests.instruction: Find the lowercase letter for Moon!
quests.question: m
quests.hint: It has two little humps side by side, like two small hills.
quests.explanation: Well done! You know your letters — m starts the word Moon.
quests.funFact: The Moon is slowly drifting away from Earth by about an inch every year!

quests.instruction: Find the lowercase letter for Nose!
quests.question: n
quests.hint: It has one little hump, like a small hill.
quests.explanation: Well done! You know your letters — n starts the word Nose.
quests.funFact: Your nose can remember up to 50,000 different scents!

quests.instruction: Find the uppercase letter for Octopus!
quests.question: O
quests.hint: It has a big round circle.
quests.explanation: Well done! You know your letters — O starts the word Octopus.
quests.funFact: An octopus has three hearts and blue blood!

quests.instruction: Find the uppercase letter for Pizza!
quests.question: P
quests.hint: It has a tall straight line with one round bump on top.
quests.explanation: Well done! You know your letters — P starts the word Pizza.
quests.funFact: The first pizza was created in Naples, Italy, in the 1800s!

quests.instruction: Find the uppercase letter for Quail!
quests.question: Q
quests.hint: It has a big circle with a small tail crossing the bottom.
quests.explanation: Well done! You know your letters — Q starts the word Quail.
quests.funFact: Quails love to take 'dust baths' to keep their feathers clean!
